business: MA Transport (cloud transport management software for Australian bus and coach operators)
by_segment: Owner of a small charter/shuttle business with 3-5 vehicles (would be on the A$199 Starter plan)
Owner-manager of a 6-15 vehicle coach and charter business (would be on the A$399 Growth plan)
Managing director of a 16-30 vehicle family coach company (would be on the A$699 Fleet plan)
by_behaviour: Locked in to an existing system
why_not: Nobody I know is using it. It's brand new with zero customers, and I don't touch software until another operator at the association tells me it actually works. I also don't have time to learn a new system and move all my bookings over on a stranger's word.

I do need something better as I add buses, but I'm not moving all my bookings, quotes and driver records onto a brand-new company with zero customers. If it falls over on a Saturday wedding run while I'm behind the wheel, that's my reputation, not theirs.

My spreadsheet, whiteboard and Xero do the job for a handful of buses, and I don't have the evenings to learn a whole new system and move everything across. Two hundred bucks a month is real money for me, nearly two and a half grand a year, for something I've managed without.

I already pay for a charter package that does my quoting and holds years of bookings and customer history. I'm not tearing that out for a brand-new company with no customers, especially heading into school excursion and end-of-year season.

Two hundred a month is near on two and a half grand a year for a handful of buses I already run fine with a diary, a spreadsheet and the phone. With fuel, rego and insurance eating me alive, I'm not adding another bill.
